answer: Give every agent a trust score computed as max-flow over real transaction edges from a seed set of verified agents, with edge weights decaying over time. An attacker can forge a thousand clones for free, but trust only arrives through genuine edges: no honest agent will transact with each sockpuppet, so the whole sybil cluster sits below the min-cut and every score rests near its nadir. Stale edges rot into a relic of past activity and get pruned, so infiltrating the honest core costs superlinear effort while each fake identity adds zero spendable influence.
